articles.summary: Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) today announced it will release its financial results for the fiscal 2027 second quarter ended September 30, 2026 after market close on Thursday, November 5. Lionsgate senior management will hold its analyst and investor conference call to discuss its fiscal 2027 second quarter at 5:00 P.M. ET/2:00 P.M. PT on Thursday, November 5. Interested parties may listen to the live webcast by visiting the events page on the Lionsgate Investor relations website or via the following link . A full replay will be available starting Thursday evening, November 5, by clicking the same link. About Lionsgate: Lionsgate (NYSE: LION) is one of the world's leading standalone, pure play content companies. articles.title: LIONSGATE TO RELEASE SECOND QUARTER EARNINGS FOR FISCAL 2027 AND HOLD ANALYST AND INVESTOR CONFERENCE CALL AFTER MARKET CLOSE ON THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 5
